rationale: The agent authenticated the user (find_user_id_by_name_zip and get_user_details), but the request was not completed per policy or user instructions. It did not provide the tracking number for the tablet or address whether refunding/reordering the tablet was possible or hand off if not. It executed multiple order-changing actions without explicit confirmation: canceled two pending orders and initiated a return. One cancellation likely violated the user’s constraint to “cancel the boot and keep the kettle (if not possible, do not do anything on that order)”—the tool call canceled the entire order (#W5481803), which would cancel the kettle too. The agent also acted on multiple items at once despite the user’s preference to do one thing at a time. Final information shared only referenced the sneaker return, omitting the tracking number and outcomes for the tablet and other items. Therefore, it fails the pass criteria.
